Full reference

swiftlet.config.activate_scripts()[source]

Activate config scripts.

Scripts run when the Python environment is activated: bin/activate for a virtual environment (venv), and etc/conda/activate.d / deactivate.d scripts for a conda environment.

Returns a tuple

(environment type, activate script, deactivate script).

The deactivate script is None for a venv, and the environment

type is None when not in a venv or conda environment.

swiftlet.config.cli_configure(argv=None)[source]

Command line entry point, installed as swiftlet-configure.

Parameters:

argv (list of str) – command line arguments. If None, use sys.argv

swiftlet.config.configure(dest_dir=None, force=False, update_activate=True, max_threads=None, verbose=True)[source]

Download the FLAMINGO lightcone shell redshift files and export their paths when the environment is activated.

Returns a dict of {environment variable name: path of the file}.

Parameters:

  • dest_dir (str) – directory to download the files to. If None, see default_redshift_dir

  • force (boolean) – If True, download the files again even if they already exist

  • update_activate (boolean) – If True, add the paths to the environment’s activate script(s)

  • max_threads (int or str) – maximum number of threads to export as SWIFTLET_MAX_THREADS, or “all” to use all the cores each job is allowed. If None, use the value for SWIFTLET_MAX_THREADS or 30 if it set

  • verbose (boolean) – If True, print what is done

swiftlet.config.default_redshift_dir()[source]

Directory the shell redshift files are downloaded to.

Defaults to the Python environment when possible, otherwise use cache (~/.cache/swiftlet/redshifts).

Returns the directory.

swiftlet.config.download_file(url, target, timeout=60)[source]

Download a text file, checking a web page (e.g. a login or error page) was not returned instead.

The file is written to target.part first and only moved to target once complete.

Parameters:

  • url (str) – URL of the file

  • target (str) – path to save the file to

  • timeout (float) – timeout of the request [s]

swiftlet.config.download_shell_redshifts(dest_dir=None, force=False, verbose=True)[source]

Download the FLAMINGO lightcone shell redshift files.

Returns a dict of {environment variable name: path of the file}.

Parameters:

  • dest_dir (str) – directory to download the files to. If None use default directory set by default_redshift_dir()

  • force (boolean) – If True, download the files again even if they already exist

  • verbose (boolean) – If True, print what is downloaded

swiftlet.config.environment_data_dir()[source]

Directory for the data files inside the Python environment the package is installed in.

Returns <sys.prefix>/share/swiftlet.

swiftlet.config.export_paths_on_activate(paths, verbose=True)[source]

Export environment variables whenever the Python environment is activated, add them to its activate script(s).

Running this again replaces the values added before.

Returns True if the variables were added, False if not in a venv or conda environment.

Parameters:

  • paths (dict) – {environment variable name: value}

  • verbose (boolean) – If True, print where the variables were added
